chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Rabat, from Ibn Muskaan, from al-Halby, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
When the Hadd (penalty) is established upon the thief, he is exiled to another city.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on exiling a thief after the Hadd penalty is established?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the post-punishment exile (Nafy) of a thief to a different locality, a measure designed to prevent recidivism by removing the offender from their established social network and familiar territory. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling underscores the preventive aspect of Hadd penalties, where the physical displacement serves as a deterrent to future theft within the community.
